scripts.dev:services: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -k -n web,http,worker -c blue,green,yellow "pnpm --filter @five/web dev" "pnpm --filter @five/backend dev:http" "pnpm --filter @five/backend dev:worker"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @five/api-contract build && pnpm --filter @five/backend build && pnpm --filter @five/web build
scripts.check: pnpm contract:check && pnpm calendar:golden:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.contract:check: pnpm contract:lint && pnpm contract:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/api-contract/src/generated.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @five/api-contract typecheck && pnpm --filter @five/backend typecheck && pnpm --filter @five/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @five/api-contract test && pnpm --filter @five/backend test && pnpm --filter @five/web test
scripts.local:setup: node scripts/ensure-local-env.mjs && pnpm infra:up && pnpm db:migrate
scripts.smoke: pnpm local:setup && pnpm postgres:integration:check && pnpm build && dotenv -e .env -- node scripts/smoke.mjs
